verdict.rationale: Reducto documents an official MCP server, in both local and hosted modes. It lets agents in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf or any other MCP client classify, parse, extract, split and edit documents without custom integration code, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: agents in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, or any other Model Context Protocol client can classify, parse, extract, split, and edit documents as part of their reasoning loop, without custom integration code.
choose local MCP for local files and hosted MCP for public URLs.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.reducto.ai/mcp-server
